game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Wolf Watch, a lookout against wolves: the snow ranger must handle icicle bats while practicing functions. Core idea – Parameter Potion: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions.
theme: Snowy Hold – Wolf Watch: a lookout against wolves
core_gameplay_loop: In Wolf Watch, repeat each round: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the potions value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 5 consecutive correct decisions about potions to power up the snow ranger and open the watch bell.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Parameter Potion
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Parameter Potion' (Week 6 slot 2), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Wolf Watch'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against icicle bats in Wolf Watch.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 5.
